record.name: Technological Evolution

universal_access.description: Ultimate adaptive technology that evolves in response to threats

record.narrative: You activate self-evolving nanite systems that adapt to counter any threat in real-time, your technology learning and improving faster than enemies can adapt. The power manifests as visible nanite swarms reconfiguring your equipment mid-combat, weaknesses eliminated as they're exploited, countermeasures developed instantaneously—evolution compressed from millennia into moments.
record.flavor_text: "You cant fight what learns from every mistake faster than you can make them." - Evolutionary Engineer

base_effect.description: You gain technology that evolves to counter threats.

mechanics.notes: Gain resistance to damage types that hit you (stacks during duration)
Gain +2 AC against creatures that have hit you before
Gain advantage on saves against effects you've encountered before

class_synergies.narrative: The Engineer's understanding of evolutionary algorithms creates perfect adaptation. Their systems don't just counter threats—they predict variants, developing countermeasures to attacks that haven't been used yet through pattern analysis.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Engineers gain immunity (not just resistance) after being hit 3 times by same damage type.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability synergizes perfectly with evolutionary technology. Their flexible nature accelerates nanite adaptation, creating feedback loops where biological and technological evolution reinforce each other exponentially.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain resistances after being hit once instead of twice.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Empire's evolutionary technology is weapons-grade—designed to overwhelm enemies through rapid tactical superiority. Their systems learn to exploit weaknesses as fast as they discover them, each encounter making them deadlier.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Imperial evolution also grants +2 damage to creatures you've hit before.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe nanites visibly reconfiguring equipment mid-combat—armor plating shifting to deflect repeated attacks, shields tuning to block specific damage types. Show the adaptation happening in real-time, enemies' frustration mounting as their tactics stop working.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Technological Evolution grants adaptive resistance, improved AC, and save advantages against repeated threats for 1 hour with concentration, costing 9 Tech Points. Game-breaking defensive power that becomes stronger the longer combat lasts. Perfect for boss fights where learning enemy patterns matters.
narrative_hooks: Evolution allows victory against impossible odds through adaptation
The self-improving technology develops unexpected sentience
Perfect adaptation reveals an exploitable pattern in the evolution itself
